rules.detection: API health probe fails or upload test cannot reach store
rules.preserve: Invitation, purpose choices, unexposed slot
rules.participant_message: Connection unavailable. Your case has not started; retry the connection check.

rules.detection: Private object-store write preflight fails
rules.preserve: Unexposed slot and case allocation
rules.participant_message: Video storage is unavailable. Wait here; your timer has not started.

rules.detection: API probe fails; capture process and local byte writes remain healthy; all required reveals delivered
rules.preserve: Local media bytes, case pin and server deadline
rules.participant_message: Connection lost. Keep this tab open; your original timer continues.

rules.detection: A required timed reveal is not delivered at its scheduled event
rules.preserve: Case exposure and event history
rules.participant_message: A required case update was missed. We will review a replacement; this answer is not scored.

rules.detection: API resumes before deadline; capture lease and local bytes reconcile
rules.preserve: Original case, deadline and contiguous media
rules.participant_message: Connection restored. Continue the same recording until the original timer ends.

rules.detection: Part transfer fails or API is unreachable after capture stopped
rules.preserve: Finished local bytes, successful part receipts and deadline
rules.participant_message: Your recording is saved on this device. Reconnect to finish uploading it.

rules.detection: A part URL expires while the upload window is open
rules.preserve: Finished bytes and confirmed parts
rules.participant_message: Refreshing the upload connection; keep this page open.

rules.detection: Local chunk write fails or quota is exhausted
rules.preserve: Recorded failure and any recoverable partial bytes
rules.participant_message: This device could not save the full recording. The answer will not be scored; contact support.

rules.detection: Capture lease ends without a completed source recording
rules.preserve: Case exposure, server start and any partial media
rules.participant_message: The recording stopped unexpectedly. We will review a replacement case.

rules.detection: Browser returns with a finished local blob matching the pinned assignment
rules.preserve: Finished bytes and server upload attempt
rules.participant_message: We found your finished recording. You can resume its upload.

rules.detection: Camera or microphone track ends or permission is revoked
rules.preserve: Case exposure and partial media
rules.participant_message: Recording equipment stopped. This attempt will not be scored; we will review recovery options.

rules.detection: Challenge API fails while local capture continues
rules.preserve: Server-acknowledged start, local bytes and delivered reveals
rules.participant_message: The service is unavailable. Keep recording only if the case remains complete; we will verify this session.

rules.detection: Start transaction cannot be committed
rules.preserve: Invitation and unexposed slot
rules.participant_message: The service is temporarily unavailable. Your case has not started.

rules.detection: Part list, digest, size, format or probe check fails
rules.preserve: Failure evidence, finished local bytes if intact
rules.participant_message: We could not verify the upload. Keep the original file on this device while we check it.

rules.detection: Approved upload window expires before verified commit
rules.preserve: Exposure, attempt and transfer evidence
rules.participant_message: The upload window ended. Support will review this attempt; no score was assigned.

rules.detection: ASR job fails or returns unusable text
rules.preserve: Verified media object and pinned configuration
rules.participant_message: Your answer was received. Transcription needs review; no new recording is needed.

rules.detection: Scorer or rater job fails or duplicate completion conflicts
rules.preserve: Verified source, transcript lineage and prior ratings
rules.participant_message: Your answer is safe. Feedback is delayed while review continues.

rules.detection: Two browser clients claim the capture lease for one assignment
rules.preserve: Original lease, event sequence and any capture bytes
rules.participant_message: This session is open elsewhere. Return to the original tab or contact support.

rules.detection: Participant requests withdrawal or revokes the necessary processing action
rules.preserve: Rights request, audit lineage and prior permitted records pending policy execution
rules.participant_message: Your session has stopped. You can review the status of your data request here.

rules.detection: Case owner holds the assigned form for exposure, leak or safety
rules.preserve: Case exposure, assignment and hold reason
rules.participant_message: This case is unavailable. We will review the next valid option for your session.
